text: Ichihime
Our fun mahjong class is starting now, nyaa! Let's hear some applause!
Sakura Matou
I-I look forward to your guidance...!
Rin Tohsaka
O-Okay!
You better not forget that we're not learning how to play mahjong in order to win the competition.
We just need to identify and track down the kidnappers to find Emiya.
Huh? There's nothing I can't do!
Fu Ji
N-Not at all. I didn't expect there would be another competition at this time.
In this city, if you look past the scale, there's some kind of mahjong competition going on every day.
It looks like they have started over there. Let's get started too.
Okay, I'm ready!
O-Okay.
By the way, aren't the other two going to learn too?
They'll focus on tracking down the kidnappers. They won't be participating in the competition.
Well, um...
Sorry... It's hard to explain...
S-Sorry…
People like you are very suitable for playing mahjong.
Okay.
Tohsaka senpai also... Oh, you're reading this book too.
Huh? Yes, but I was reading it while listening to Ichihime's lecture.
...The whole book?
Um, well, I...
Hey, wait up, Sakura!
...Sigh, what was I thinking?
S-Someone like me...
Oh...
Sorry...
Nothing... It's nothing serious.
...I will never be able to surpass her.
What makes mahjong fun...?
...Mahjong is a game that's meant to be played with others. Is that it?
That answer is very you, but that's not it.
What makes mahjong fun is that whether you win or lose depends heavily on luck.
L-Luck...?
Even someone skilled like me will lose when things just aren't meant to be.
At the end of the day, it's all about luck.
But in that case, I'm even more...
Really...?
...I'm sorry for making you wait so long.
...Okay, let's learn from each other!
...That's terrible, going all out on beginners like that.
...Hey, Sakura.
...What is it?
Well...
...Oh, it looks like you're finally getting competitive.
Fun Mahjong Class
Luck and Fortune
Luck and Fortune - Courtyard
I can't hear you clearly, nyaa! You won't win the mahjong competition if you speak so softly. Show me your spirit!
A small mahjong competition will be held in the city tomorrow before the competition held at Mahjong Soul Shrine this weekend.

The kidnappers will definitely keep an eye on tomorrow's competition to see if there are any skilled players in the competition and whether they will participate in the weekend competition at Mahjong Soul Shrine.
We're just joining this competition as bait. We only need a crash course on some basic knowledge – not enough to win it.
Stop right there, nyaa! Just bait? It doesn't matter if you win or not? If you're that timid, you'll blow matches you could've won. The kidnappers wouldn't even glance your way, nyaa!
If you're competing as my apprentices, your goal is to win the competition, nyaa! Or are you telling me that it's too hard for you, nyaa?
The first thing you need to learn is vocalization, nyaa! Pon, nyaa! Chii, nyaa! Kan, nyaa!
Vocalization?! Why do we have to learn that first?!
Let's begin with the textbook. This is a beginner's textbook I borrowed from an acquaintance.
I see. Those two seem to have some hidden strength?
Don't sweat it. You don't need to say anything if it's not convenient.
I understand. There are some questions I'll never answer too.
Really? Like what, Miss Fu Ji?
Like asking about her age, nyaa? It seems that people who have asked that question all mysteriously moved away from One Han City, nyaa...
I-I see. I thought we were about the same age...
Oh! I-I'm sorry. That's not what I meant...
I'm very suitable for playing mahjong...? But I don't see how a Jyanshi's personality would give them an edge in the game...
True, but mahjong is a game with its own path to mastery. It's better to be steady and focused rather than just dreaming of instant success.
...Hehe, thank you for your kind words, Miss Fu Ji. I'm feeling more confident now.
Nyaa? It's this late already? Let's end the theory class here and play some games. It's time for the real fun now, nyaa!
Miss Fu Ji also brought this book. She said it's for beginners. I was just reading it myself.
No wonder it was so easy to understand. I finished the whole book in no time.
Now that I've read it, I think I know how to play mahjong. Let's go and play a real game with them, Sakura.
I-I'll go check on Saber! I feel bad leaving all the investigation and security work to them!
Although we could play three-player mahjong, I don't think it's the best way for a beginner to start.
I just realized that Tohsaka senpai is more than capable of performing well in tomorrow's competition and attracting the kidnappers' attention.
She is smarter and better than me. She'll definitely be able to master all the mahjong techniques easily in a short time.
Yep. It's true that skill does make a difference too. If there are two aspects to a person's mahjong ability, then one would definitely be knowledge and skill.
But the other one is luck – the draw and the flow of the game, especially when it all comes down to one final match. Nobody can predict how that'll go.
...Feeling better now?
But you never know until you try it out for real. Of course, I'm not going to go easy on you either!
Nyaa-hahaha! Nyaa-hahaha! Nyaa-hahaha!!!
I took down all three of you, nyaa! Is this what talent does?! Nyaa-hahahaha! I'm so sorry, I'm just too amazing and lucky, nyaa!
Look at their faces. If two mahjong first-timers look like that, it means this class is a total failure.
Nyaa-hahahahaha! The battlefield leaves no room for mercy, nyaa! I'm just so lucky right now that I can't stop winning, nyaa!
Nyaa-haha! Did you losers say something? I couldn't hear you clearly, nyaa! Can you speak up, nyaa?!
That's the spirit I want, nyaa! But I'm still going to win the next game, nyaa!
No matter how skilled you are or how big the gap is between your ability and your opponent's, victory is never guaranteed at the mahjong table. Is that right?
In other words... maybe we'll win the next game.
Nyaa-hahahahaha! Come on! Let's play another game, nyaa!
In that case, I'm not stopping today until we win! You okay with that, Sakura?
Okay...! Let's get our first victory here today before we battle it out in tomorrow's competition!
So you're going to be the teacher?
Fine, I'm going to win it! I never liked the idea of being bait anyway!
Oh, the atmosphere is lively... Sakura, you came up with a really great idea. Now, let me teach you how to play mahjong.
We'll start practicing after you finish reading the first chapter. Tell me when you're finished.
Come to think of it, this is the first time I've taught someone for free!
ICHI~HIME~? I wouldn't mind letting my fan explain why those people
...How old do you think I am?
Haha, I'll forgive you this time as an exception. I know you don't have any bad intentions, Sakura.
I can tell from how you're so determined to save your friend that you're an earnest, dedicated person.
You're almost perfect in that respect, Sakura. Would you be interested in joining my dojo?
Miss Ichihime, Miss Fu Ji is calling you.
Oh, so this is where you are.
M-Miss Fu Ji! Why are you here?!
...Sigh, you must have come here to look for me. I'm sorry for making you worry.
It's okay. You can just leave me here and start first.
Well, even if you say that, we need four to play mahjong.
Sakura, can you tell me what's bugging you?
If all we need is bait to find and rescue senpai, it would be more efficient for you both to focus on teaching her.
I am sorry you're missing a fourth player because of me, but please leave me alone for now.
...Let me ask you a question. What do you think makes mahjong fun?
Yep, what do you think it is?
We just met, so I can't say anything really deep.
But there's one thing I can tell you. No matter how skilled you are or how big the gap is between your ability and your opponent's, victory is never guaranteed at the mahjong table.
As long as you've had even a little bit of luck in life and you're still at the mahjong table, there's always a chance to win.
That's all I can say as a dojo master. What will you do now, Sakura?
You're finally back.
I think I have an idea of what you were thinking.
Let's put aside our competition for now. Don't you think there is something else we can't just let slide?
Let's play another game. I don't get why you're so smug about beating beginners. I'll wipe that smirk off your face soon enough!
You should be done with the first chapter by now, right? It's time for you to play a real game. Let's go and get those two over there.
